statements.formal_part: added to the Lean repository after publication (20-oct-2026): the counts (4ᵏ distinct generators, ∑ C(k,j)2ʲ = 3ᵏ), the arithmetic 4ᵏ > 2·3ᵏ − 2 for k ≥ 3 and equation (5); the proposition itself with Theorem 1 (Fischer–Morris–Shapiro, not in Mathlib) as a hypothesis; that every generator spans an extreme ray; and that the generators span a space of dimension 3ᵏ for every k (the generator matrix is the k-th Kronecker power of a 4 × 4 matrix of rank 3, through a general rank(A ⊗ B) = rank A · rank B that we proved, since no library had it, in LinearAlgebra/Matrix/Rank/Kronecker.lean). Not in Lean: Theorem 1 itself (Fischer–Morris–Shapiro), which enters only as a hypothesis
